notes: Three fixes. The Control Fan now works the way you described it: slide sideways to open it, slide UP and DOWN to move between controls, slide SIDE TO SIDE to change the one you are on — moving between controls can never change a value, and the ringer steps through its modes as you slide, so you can see it change. The Orb now restores itself when you come back to the launcher instead of waiting for a touch. And the dark phantom shape behind Reach was a shadow cast by its invisible container — removed.
